name: Meridian Analytics, Inc.
dataDisclaimer: Meridian Analytics, Inc. is a fictional company created for this portfolio project. All financial figures are illustrative demo data constructed to be internally consistent, not real disclosed filings. See DATA_SOURCES.md for the full methodology and construction notes.
overview: Meridian Analytics develops a subscription analytics and workflow platform used by mid-market and enterprise operations, finance, and supply-chain teams to consolidate reporting and forecasting. Revenue is substantially subscription-based (ARR), supplemented by implementation and professional services.
businessModel: SaaS subscriptions sold on annual contracts, priced per-seat and per-data-connector, with a smaller professional-services and implementation revenue stream. Net revenue retention and gross margin expansion are the primary levers management has emphasized.

capitalStructure.notes: Capital structure is illustrative: a single senior term loan amortizing over the model period, no preferred equity, no convertible instruments, and a flat fully-diluted share count assumed across the historical window for simplicity.

notes: This company and all figures below are fictional / illustrative, constructed for a zero-cost educational portfolio project. Do not treat any number on this site as real market or company data.
